fusions.name: Smoke Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a spore slug at a target up to 10 tiles away that deals 36 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, ignoring armour. It leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flurry of Pods
fusions.desc: Looses 5 spore pods in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. The disease is catching: it finds up to 2 more enemies within 5.5 tiles on its own.

fusions.name: Primed Puffballs
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. A cloud of spores fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smokeless Round
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a spore round hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
